eligibility.other_note: Invests in Spain, Germany, UK and Brazil

programmes.amount_note: Standard YC deal: USD 125,000 for 7% on a post-money SAFE plus USD 375,000 on an uncapped MFN SAFE, total USD 500,000. Bio and healthcare companies apply through the same general application; YC provides additional bio-specific partners and lab-cost guidance.
programmes.deadline_note: YC runs multiple batches per year (Winter, Spring, Summer and Fall) with published application deadlines; late applications are considered on a rolling basis.

programmes.amount_note: Patient, zero-dividend debt financing to social businesses in its focus countries. Typical ticket size is not published as a fixed range.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications assessed on a rolling basis by country teams. YSB also runs periodic accelerator cohorts.

eligibility.other_note: Operates in a defined set of countries including Brazil, Colombia, India, Kenya and Uganda. Businesses must be revenue-generating with a core social mission.

programmes.amount_note: No cash and no equity: 'Equity-free support for the duration of the program'. Benefits are mentoring from Google teams, technical bootcamps, early access to AI products via Trusted Tester and EAP, Cloud TPU access and, for eligible startups, unspecified 'product credits'. Google does not publish a credit value, so the amount is null.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based, run regionally as Accelerator Americas, Accelerator Europe/Middle East/Africa and Accelerator Asia Pacific. Deadlines are published per regional cohort on the regional pages; none is published on the umbrella page.

procedure_steps.detail: Select the regional accelerator (Americas, EMEA or APAC) and check its open cohorts.
Apply online during the cohort window.
Selected cohorts of 10-15 startups take part in remote and in-person 1:1 sessions, group learning and sprint projects.

eligibility.other_note: Cohorts of 10-15 startups. Specific stage, sector and country criteria are set per regional cohort and are not published on the umbrella page.

programmes.source_snippet: Equity-free support for the duration of the program

programmes.amount_note: Google Cloud credits, not cash. Tiered by funding stage: pre-funded startups 'Get $2,000 to build your MVP'; Seed to Series A 'Get up to $350,000 in credits if you're Seed to Series A' ($200,000 standard, up to $350,000 for AI-first startups); Series B+ receive custom commercial arrangements rather than a published credit figure. Credits are redeemable only against Google Cloud and Firebase usage and expire. Google does not publish age or funding-raised thresholds on the programme page.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications; no published deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Select the tier matching your funding stage on the Google for Startups Cloud Program page.
Submit the online application with company, funding and Google Cloud billing account details.
If approved, credits are applied to the Cloud Billing account.

documents_required.doc: Evidence of funding stage / investor details

eligibility.other_note: The programme page states tiers by stage (Pre-funded, Seed to Series A, Series B+) but does not publish minimum/maximum company age or a funding-raised cap.

programmes.source_snippet: Get up to $350,000 in credits if you're Seed to Series A

programmes.amount_note: Equity-free cash prize: the Hello Tomorrow site advertises 'Secure €100K equity-free' for the Grand Prize, plus track prizes and a dedicated cross-track Emerging Pioneers prize for idea/pre-seed founders. programmes.deadline_note: 12th edition; finals 2-3 June 2027 Amsterdam

procedure_steps.detail: Wait for the next edition to open (historically mid-September) and pick an industry track.
Submit the free online application before the final deadline.

Finalists pitch at the Hello Tomorrow Summit; winners receive the prizes.

programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm affiliation with an approved HubSpot partner/entrepreneurial organisation, or that funding is verifiable via Crunchbase or PitchBook.
Apply online through HubSpot for Startups.
HubSpot verifies eligibility and issues the discounted annual contract.

documents_required.doc: Partner affiliation code or investor/funding evidence

eligibility.other_note: Premium 90% tier requires pre-seed/seed/Series A funding but not Series B or later, plus approved-partner affiliation or verified venture funding. Applies to net-new Professional or Enterprise products only. 'HubSpot for Startups requires an annual commitment.'

programmes.source_snippet: Raised Pre-seed, Seed or Series A funding, but not Series B or later

programmes.amount_note: Azure credits and software benefits, not cash. Microsoft advertises 'up to $150,000 in credits' toward Azure services, plus access to AI services and developer tooling. Microsoft no longer publishes the previous four-level tier ladder or per-level credit amounts on the public page, and no longer advertises a bundled OpenAI API credit. The actual amount granted is discretionary and staged.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications; no published deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Sign up to Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub with a company email and Microsoft account.
Complete the company profile describing the product and stage.
Redeem Azure credits and benefits from the Founders Hub dashboard as tiers unlock.

eligibility.other_note: The public page states only that the programme is for 'startups ready to build fast, scale smart, and sell more'. Detailed eligibility and tier criteria are not published; verify in the Founders Hub portal.

programmes.source_snippet: up to $150,000 in credits

programmes.amount_note: MongoDB Atlas credits plus Voyage AI tokens, not cash. Four tiers are named on the page (Inspire for bootstrapped, Grow for early-funded, Innovate for VC-backed, Scale for rapidly scaling) but MongoDB does not publish the USD credit value of any tier, so the amount is recorded as null. Matching credits with Fireworks AI and Temporal are offered to eligible startups.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online via the MongoDB for Startups page.
MongoDB assigns a tier based on stage and investor backing.
Credits are applied to the MongoDB Atlas organisation.

eligibility.other_note: Base tier requires being 'Less than 7 years old and Series A or earlier', focused on a single software-based product or service (development shops and agencies are not eligible), not previously accepted into the programme, and having an active company website and LinkedIn profile. Existing Atlas users are eligible.

programmes.source_snippet: Less than 7 years old and Series A or earlier

Notion values the offer at 'up to $12,000' based on the Business plan at $20 per member per year for up to 100 employees. Three tiers by verification level: 6 months free if affiliated with a select startup partner; 3 months free with a valid business website and company-domain email; 1 month free for companies under 10 employees or with incomplete verification. Notion AI is included.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications.

procedure_steps.detail: Create a Notion workspace using a company-domain work email.
Submit the Notion for Startups form, including a partner code if you have one.
Credit is applied to the workspace for the qualifying number of free months.

documents_required.doc: Work email on a company domain

eligibility.other_note: Must be a 'non-paying Notion customer with a valid work email (no Gmail, Outlook, etc), have not received any previous Notion promotions, and have fewer than 100 employees'. No company-age or funding criteria are published.

programmes.source_snippet: non-paying Notion customer with a valid work email (no Gmail, Outlook, etc), have not received any previous Notion promotions, and have fewer than 100 employees

programmes.amount_note: No cash and no fixed credit figure is published. Benefits are in-kind: 'Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners', preferred pricing on select NVIDIA hardware and software, free Deep Learning Institute training credits, investor and co-marketing exposure. NVIDIA states 'Inception is free. The program doesn't have application fees, membership fees, or equity requirements.' Any dollar figures circulating in blogs are not published by NVIDIA, so amount is recorded as null.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling; membership applications accepted at any time.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online via the NVIDIA Inception page with company details and website.
NVIDIA verifies incorporation, developer headcount and website.
On acceptance, access partner cloud credits, preferred hardware pricing and DLI training via the Inception portal.

eligibility.other_note: Members must 'Employ at least one developer', 'Maintain a working website', 'Be officially incorporated' and 'Be less than 10 years old'. Explicitly excluded: consulting firms, cryptocurrency-associated companies, cloud service providers, resellers/distributors and public companies.

programmes.source_snippet: Inception is free. The program doesn't have application fees, membership fees, or equity requirements.

Submit the credits request with the referral code, product description and API use case.
Track credit usage in the OpenAI platform billing settings once granted.

Company name, team contacts and basic funding details

Submit the application describing your background and what you intend to build.
Selected participants join five weeks of in-person workshops, office hours and mentoring.

programmes.amount_note: No fixed figure is published. The Foundation states the grant is 'The equivalent of a year's salary, a contribution towards expenses plus access to a travel allowance', with the total 'based on the Fellow's qualifications, experience and comparable cost of time for their skill level'. Fellows can additionally access project funding matched by the Foundation 'by at least ten fold' against the Fellow's own personal investment. Amount recorded as null deliberately.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications accepted throughout the year with two intakes: applications for the 1 September intake close 1 May; applications for the 1 March intake close 1 November.

procedure_steps.detail: Read the application instructions document.
Complete the application form (ODT) and email it to the fellowships address.
Applications are reviewed by the Foundation management team and advisors; shortlisted candidates are interviewed.
Fellowship starts on 1 March or 1 September and runs one year, renewable on reapplication.

documents_required.note: ODT form supplied by the Foundation; partial applications are not accepted

eligibility.other_note: Fellowships are awarded to individuals, not companies. Applicants must have an innovative idea for social change in knowledge, learning and technology, be fluent in English and have attained the age of majority. Not limited to any geography; not an academic/research fellowship. Fellows must commit 100% of their time and attend bi-annual gatherings.

programmes.source_snippet: The equivalent of a year's salary, a contribution towards expenses plus access to a travel allowance.

Snowflake follows up to scope the first contract and free usage allocation.

Submit the entry showing how you use emerging technologies (voice, identity, generative AI) with a working functional demo.
Judging late September to late October 2026; honorees announced mid-to-late November 2026.

programmes.source_snippet: Receive a one-time grant of up to $10,000 USD in Twilio credits

programmes.amount_note: This is EQUITY, not a grant. YC states 'We invest $500,000' in every accepted company, structured as '$125,000 on a post-money safe in return for 7% of your company' plus '$375,000 on an uncapped safe with a Most Favored Nation ("MFN") provision'. YC also takes pro rata rights to invest in subsequent rounds. Funding is not contingent on milestones and starts the day a company is accepted.
programmes.deadline_note: Winter 2027 batch; on-time deadline 2 November 8pm PT, decision by 11 December; late applications still considered; future batches can be applied to via Early Decision

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the online application for the target batch, including a founder video.
Shortlisted teams are interviewed.
Accepted companies sign the standard deal documents and are funded from the day of acceptance.
Participate in the three-month batch in San Francisco, ending in Demo Day.

eligibility.other_note: Open to founders anywhere, but the batch is run in person in San Francisco. YC does not publish company-age, revenue or headcount limits.

programmes.source_snippet: $125,000 on a post-money safe in return for 7% of your company
